statements: Hello there. I met Ada yesterday and Ada Lovelace today.
We asked the Fryer and then Fryer said no.
The Countess of Lovelace wrote it, said Grace Hopper.
Then Grete and Margarethe Kellar went with Kognova to the Sunstone office.
Ask Solstone, or ask Catherin about Kathryn.
We met Jean-Luc Picard and Captain Janeway at the Strasse Cafe.
I told Fillip and Tomson, ok?

Ada, please call AAL.
Then Friar went home
Our Cognova Labs deal; Philip agreed.
